changelog: New: opt-in card database auto-update — enable 'Check for updates on launch' in Settings to see a banner when Scryfall ships new cards; optionally let the app auto-download the update in the background
New: 'What changed' modal — after an update ingest, see a collapsible Added / Updated / Removed list of oracle cards so you know exactly what Scryfall just added or errata'd
New: 'Check for updates now' button in Settings for on-demand checks
Improved: Ingest now records the Scryfall bulk timestamp + local completion time so future update checks can tell 'you already have this build' apart from 'you haven't synced in a week'
